import ast, hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess
root = pathlib.Path(".").resolve()
pro = root.parent / "orze-pro"
sha = lambda raw: hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
snapshots = {
"docs/evidence/snapshots/v1-05c2e1-before-cli.py": "src/orze/cli.py",
"docs/evidence/snapshots/v1-05c2e1-before-cli_setup.py": "src/orze/cli_setup.py",
"docs/evidence/snapshots/v1-05c2e1-before-cluster.py": "src/orze/engine/cluster.py",
"docs/evidence/snapshots/v1-05c2e1-before-lifecycle.py": "src/orze/lifecycle.py",
"docs/evidence/snapshots/v1-05c2e1-before-gpu-lease-tests.py": "tests/test_gpu_lease.py",
"docs/evidence/snapshots/v1-05c2e1-before-managed-run-results-fixture.py": "tests/test_managed_run.py",
}
out = {"baseline_snapshots": [], "draft_snapshots": [], "new_tests": []}
for path, source in snapshots.items():
    raw = (root / path).read_bytes()
    assert raw == subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", "25e331c9aa06b415603a69fc299b435a51398891:" + source]), path
    assert raw.endswith(b"\n")
    ast.parse(raw)
    out["baseline_snapshots"].append({"repo": "core", "path": path, "source": source, "sha256": sha(raw)})
pro_snapshots = {
"docs/evidence/snapshots/v1-05c2e1-before-director.py": "src/orze_pro/agents/director.py",
"docs/evidence/snapshots/v1-05c2e1-original-test_director_control_paths.py": "tests/test_director_control_paths.py",
"docs/evidence/snapshots/v1-05c2e1-original-test_director_dispatch_receipts.py": "tests/test_director_dispatch_receipts.py",
"docs/evidence/snapshots/v1-05c2e1-original-test_director_target_actions.py": "tests/test_director_target_actions.py",
}
for path, source in pro_snapshots.items():
    raw = (pro / path).read_bytes()
    assert raw == subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(pro), "show", "b434dc9d4f7f2adba59b4391c0d471ae925f686c:" + source]), path
    assert raw.endswith(b"\n")
    ast.parse(raw)
    out["baseline_snapshots"].append({"repo": "pro", "path": path, "source": source, "sha256": sha(raw)})
for repo, path in [
("core", "docs/evidence/snapshots/v1-05c2e1-before-enable-stop-hold-cli.py"),
("core", "docs/evidence/snapshots/v1-05c2e1-before-subcommand-upgrade-cli.py"),
("pro", "docs/evidence/snapshots/v1-05c2e1-before-reallocation-ack-director.py")]:
    raw = ((root if repo == "core" else pro) / path).read_bytes()
    ast.parse(raw)
    assert raw.endswith(b"\n")
    out["draft_snapshots"].append({"repo": repo, "path": path, "sha256": sha(raw)})
for repo, directory, paths in [
("core", root, ["tests/test_cli_stop_authority.py","tests/test_cluster_orphan_authority.py","tests/test_control_outcome.py","tests/test_controller_enable_stop_hold.py","tests/test_controller_start_stop_admission.py","tests/test_stop_request_publication.py","tests/test_cli_upgrade_stop_authority.py"]),
("pro", pro, ["tests/test_director_stop_ownership.py","tests/test_director_stop_contract.py","tests/test_director_reallocation_ack.py"])]:
    for path in paths:
        raw = (directory / path).read_bytes()
        out["new_tests"].append({"repo": repo, "path": path, "sha256": sha(raw),
            "assert_nodes": sum(isinstance(n, ast.Assert) for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(raw)))})
before = ast.parse((root / "docs/evidence/snapshots/v1-05c2e1-before-gpu-lease-tests.py").read_bytes())
after = ast.parse((root / "tests/test_gpu_lease.py").read_bytes())
before_function = next(n for n in before.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "test_stop_orphan_probe_can_be_restricted_to_explicit_scope")
after_function = next(n for n in after.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "test_stop_orphan_fallback_does_not_probe_or_infer_gpu_ownership")
out["gpu_fixture_versioning"] = {
"old_case": before_function.name, "new_case": after_function.name,
"old_asserts": sum(isinstance(n, ast.Assert) for n in ast.walk(before_function)),
"new_asserts": sum(isinstance(n, ast.Assert) for n in ast.walk(after_function)),
"old_function_ast": ast.dump(before_function, include_attributes=False),
"new_function_ast": ast.dump(after_function, include_attributes=False)}
before.body.remove(before_function)
after.body.remove(after_function)
assert ast.dump(before, include_attributes=False) == ast.dump(after, include_attributes=False)
out["gpu_fixture_versioning"]["all_other_module_ast_equal"] = True
out["assert_nodes_total"] = sum(entry["assert_nodes"] for entry in out["new_tests"])
print(json.dumps(out, sort_keys=True))
PY
